languageModelTools.name: rigel_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the current workspace.

languageModelTools.name: rigel_listFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the direct children of a directory inside the current workspace.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path, or . for the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: rigel_findFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find workspace files matching a glob pattern.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return, from 1 to 200.

languageModelTools.name: rigel_writeFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file inside the current workspace. Requires confirmation.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 contents of the file.

languageModelTools.name: rigel_runCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a bounded shell command in the workspace root. Requires confirmation.

command.description: Shell command to run in the workspace root.

commands.title: Rigel: Choose Favorite Model by Category

rigel.defaultCategory.markdownDescription: GitHub model category used by a plain `@rigel` request. Rigel selects the favorite model for this category, or its cheapest available model.

rigel.maxToolActions.description: Maximum tool actions before Rigel asks the current model to finish without more tools. Repetition and error loops can still trigger escalation earlier.

rigel.repeatedActionLimit.description: Number of equivalent tool calls that triggers the circuit breaker.

rigel.repeatedErrorLimit.description: Number of equivalent tool errors that triggers the circuit breaker.

rigel.favoriteModels.markdownDescription: Favorite Copilot model ID for each GitHub category. Use **Rigel: Choose Favorite Model by Category** to configure this interactively.
